phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Develop safety, mobility, and basic conditioning at moderate intensity

phases.name: Adaptation
phases.focus: Increase aerobic base and movement quality within HR limits

phases.name: Progression
phases.focus: Enhance strength and endurance with controlled loads and progressive volume

non_negotiables: Cardiac rehab cleared him for moderate-intensity only

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week beginner cardiac rehab general fitness program (moderate intensity, no max lifts)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "Safe, progressive, moderate-intensity fitness program for a 58-year-old male, 6 months post-MI. Emphasis on mobility, cardio base, and submax strength within HR limits."
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Foundation - mobility and activation>":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) squat_bodyweight 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          2) goblet_squat 2x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Foundation - moderate cardio>":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) cycling 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_walk 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - upper body submax>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) bench_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          2) lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - lower body submax>":
        warmup:
          leg_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) leg_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          2) leg_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks) continued:
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Foundation - mobility progression>":
        warmup:
          marching_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) hip_external_rotation 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          2) hip_adduction/abduction 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Foundation - steady state cardio>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) walking 25m steady_state rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          slower_walk 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - upper body progression>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) incline_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          2) cable_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - lower body progression>":
        warmup:
          ankle_mots 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          2) step_up 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Foundation - mobility & activation>":
        warmup:
          march 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          2) planks_short 2x15s rest 30s
        cooldown:
          couch_stretch 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Foundation - cardio progression>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) cycling 15m rpe 5 rest 0s
        cooldown:
          easy_breath 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - upper body steady>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) dumbbell_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) rear_delt_fly 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - lower body steady>":
        warmup:
          ankle_mob 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) leg_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) calf_raise 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Foundation - consolidate>":
        warmup:
          march 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) bird_dog 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
          2) glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Foundation - maintain moderate intensity>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) walking 20m + incline 0% steady 5-6 RPE
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - upper body intro>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) bench_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Foundation - lower body intro>":
        warmup:
          hip_mocket 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) leg_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Adaptation - mobility and prep>":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) hip_mowl 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
          2) scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_stretch 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Adaptation - aerobic base>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) cycle_ergometer 25m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          easy_breath 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Adaptation - push/pull>":
        warmup:
          shoulder_activation 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) incline_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) cable_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Adaptation - hinge/quad>":
        warmup:
          hip_prog 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) deadlift_gobo 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) leg_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Adaptation - mobility flow>":
        warmup:
          mobility_flow 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) planks 2x20s
          2) glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Adaptation - progressing intensity>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) walking_tempo 25m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Adaptation - upper)":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) dumbbell_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Adaptation - lower)":
        warmup:
          ankle_mob 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) leg_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Progression" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Progression - consolidate safety>":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
          2) dead_bug 2x12 rpe 4 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          thoracic_stretch 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Progression - aerobic mix>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) rowing 20m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          slow_breath 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Progression - strength quality>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) bench_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) dumbbell_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Progression - volume>":
        warmup:
          hip_mob 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) leg_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Progression - mobility maintenance>":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) planks 2x25s
          2) bird_dog 2x12 rpe 4
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Progression - longer steady state>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) cycle 25m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          easy_breath 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Progression - submax>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) incline_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) cable_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Progression - submax cont>":
        warmup:
          ankle_mob 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) leg_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Progression - refine>":
        warmup:
          mobility_flow 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 4
          2) hollow_hold 2x20s
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Progression - varied modalities>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) rowing 20m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          slow_breath 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Progression - controlled load>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) dumbbell_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Progression - controlled load cont>":
        warmup:
          hip_mob 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) leg_press 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Mobility/Activation training 40m "<Foundation-to-Progression wrap>":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) planks 2x30s
          2) bird_dog 2x12
        cooldown:
          thoracic_stretch 2m
      DAY Cardio/Endurance training 40m "<Final progress check cardio>":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretches 5m
        main straight_sets:
          1) walking_tempo 25m rpe 5 rest 60s
        cooldown:
          slow_walk 5m
      DAY Strength_upper_body_submax 40m "<Final upper body submax>":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) incline_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) cable_row 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Strength_lower_body_submax 40m "<Final lower body submax>":
        warmup:
          ankle_mob 2m
        main straight_sets:
          1) goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
          2) leg_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 90s
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
